lines.en: label day12:
scene hall_noon
And so another day passes by without anything interesting happening.
lines.zh: 于是，又一天过去了，什么有趣的事都没发生。

lines.en: You'd think that being reincarnated into a world where the only people I have to talk to are teenage girls would be a little more...I don't know, fun?
lines.zh: 你会以为，转生到一个我唯一能说话的对象只有十几岁女生的世界里，应该会……怎么说呢，更有趣一点？

lines.en: But apparently, this world is going to be just as boring as the last.
lines.zh: 但显然，这个世界会和上一个一样无聊。

lines.en: Not like I {i}remember{/i} anything about the last, but...
lines.zh: 虽然上一个世界的事我什么都不{i}记得{/i}了，不过……

lines.en: You get the point.
lines.zh: 意思你懂的。

lines.en: Originally, I was planning on getting some of my mandatory {i}counseling{/i} hours out of the way after school but, at the behest of Makoto, it seems everyone has been forced into studying instead of going home.
lines.zh: 本来我打算放学后把必须完成的{i}心理咨询{/i}时数给刷掉，但在 Makoto 的要求下，似乎所有人都被强制留下来学习，不许回家。

lines.en: As such, I am currently on my way to the library to personally assist her in tutoring the one girl who needs it more than anyone- Miku.
lines.zh: 因此，我此刻正前往图书馆，去亲自协助她辅导那个比谁都更需要补课的女生——Miku。

lines.en: With standardized tests looming on the horizon and the future of the soccer team's ace hanging in the balance, it falls on one man (Me) to make sure everything turns out okay.
lines.zh: 统一考试迫在眉睫，足球队王牌的前途悬于一线，确保一切顺利的重任，就落在了一个男人（我）的肩上。

lines.en: Thankfully, I have a foolproof strategy when it comes to situations as dire as this.
lines.zh: 所幸，面对如此危急的局面，我有一套万无一失的策略。

lines.en: scene libstudy1
: ...and that’s why it’s called “pi.”
lines.zh: : ……所以这才叫「pi（派）」。

lines.en: : I somehow feel even more lost now.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么的，我现在更迷糊了。

lines.en: And that strategy is letting Makoto do everything while I sit back and watch.
lines.zh: 而那套策略就是：让 Makoto 包办一切，我坐在旁边看戏。

lines.en: : Hey, you two.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们俩。

lines.en: scene libstudy2
: Oh, Sensei! Great timing!
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！来得正好！

lines.en: : I was just telling Miku that “pi” is only called “pi” because it’s named after the Greek word ‘perimitros’ which translates to ‘perimeter.’
lines.zh: : 我刚跟 Miku 说，「pi」之所以叫「pi」，是因为它得名于希腊语的『perimitros』，翻译过来就是『周长』。

lines.en: : Awesome.
lines.zh: : 厉害。

lines.en: : And how are you holding up, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你还撑得住吗，Miku？

lines.en: scene libstudy3
: I {i}thought{/i} I was doin’ okay! But then Makoto started sayin' all this stuff about pi and now I'm just hungry!
lines.zh: : 我{i}本来觉得{/i}自己还行！可 Makoto 一开始讲这些派什么的东西，我现在就只觉得饿了！

lines.en: : Just eat Makoto. She's rich in nutrients.
lines.zh: : 那就把 Makoto 吃了吧。她营养丰富。

lines.en: scene libstudy4
: She is?!
lines.zh: : 我营养丰富？！

lines.en: : Hmm...You think so? Seems kinda {i}lean{/i} to me. Could probably do with a little more meat on her bones.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你觉得是吗？我看她{i}挺瘦的{/i}。骨头上的肉大概还能再多一点。

lines.en: : 'Sides, Makoto uses coconut shampoo and I don't even like coconuts. I say we all just go get pie instead.
lines.zh: : 再说了，Makoto 用椰子味洗发水，我又不喜欢椰子。要不咱们干脆去吃派吧。

lines.en: : Can you do something about this before we start getting even {i}more{/i} sidetracked? There's no time to eat right now!
lines.zh: : 趁我们还没跑题跑得{i}更{/i}远，你能不能管管？现在没时间吃东西！

lines.en: : Don't worry, Makoto. I like coconuts and am not opposed to eating you.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Makoto。我喜欢椰子，也不介意把你吃掉。

lines.en: scene libstudy5
: Okay, ignore him. We have things to learn.
lines.zh: : 好，别理他。我们还有东西要学。

lines.en: : Come on, relax. A minute or two of joking around won't kill you, will it?
lines.zh: : 拜托，放松点。开一两句玩笑又不会要你的命，对吧？

lines.en: scene libstudy6
: Sensei, it’s absolutely imperative that we teach Miku everything her brain can handle before the standardized tests begin.
lines.zh: : Sensei，在统一考试开始之前，把 Miku 脑子能装下的东西全塞进去，是绝对必要的。

lines.en: : Don't mean to interrupt, Makoto...but ya might be overestimatin' just how much my brain can handle.
lines.zh: : 不好意思打断一下，Makoto……不过你可能高估了我这脑子能装多少东西。

lines.en: : I've been at my limit for a little while already...
lines.zh: : 我其实早就到极限了……

lines.en: : Alternatively, what if we just...{i}don't{/i} do that?
lines.zh: : 要不这样，我们干脆……{i}别{/i}那么干？

lines.en: : I think we should listen to the teacher, Makoto. He knows what he's doin'.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们该听老师的，Makoto。他知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: : We can't just give up before we've even started, Sensei. Do you have any idea how horrible Miku is when it comes to science?
lines.zh: : 我们不能在还没开始之前就放弃啊，Sensei。你知道 Miku 在理科上有多糟糕吗？

lines.en: : Well, which science are we talking about? Because some science is just flat out-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们说的是哪门理科？因为有些理科简直就是——

lines.en: : Biology.
lines.zh: : 生物。

lines.en: : Nevermind. It is absolutely imperative that we teach Miku about this subject.
lines.zh: : 当我没说。教 Miku 这门课是绝对必要的。

lines.en: scene libstudy7
: You traitor! What happened to bein' on my side?!
lines.zh: : 叛徒！你不是说好站我这边的吗？！

lines.en: : We were supposed to eat pie together! It wasn't meant to be like this!
lines.zh: : 我们说好要一起去吃派的！事情不该是这样的！

lines.en: : Some things are just more important than pie, Miku.
lines.zh: : 有些东西就是比派更重要，Miku。

lines.en: : So, what are you struggling with when it comes to biology? The reproductive system? Mating habits?
lines.zh: : 那么，生物方面你哪里搞不懂？生殖系统？交配习性？

lines.en: scene libstudy8
: Umm...
: Well...actually...
: I was kinda hopin' that...
lines.zh: : 我其实有点希望……

lines.en: : Maybe...you could teach me a little about...
lines.zh: : 也许……你能教我一点关于……

lines.en: scene libstudy9
: Mitochondria?...
lines.zh: : 线粒体？……

lines.en: Being a teacher sucks.
lines.zh: 当老师真他妈糟。

lines.en: : Miku, why are you blushing? I could have sworn this conversation was going in a different direction.
lines.zh: : Miku，你脸红什么？我明明以为这段对话是要往另一个方向发展的。

lines.en: : Obviously cause I'm embarrassed about bein' all dumb and stuff.
lines.zh: : 当然是因为我为自己这么笨什么的感到害臊啊。

lines.en: : Sensei...I'm really countin' on ya here.
lines.zh: : Sensei……这次我真的全靠你了。

lines.en: : Teach me everything there is to know about mitochondria.
lines.zh: : 把线粒体的一切都教给我吧。

lines.en: : Should I volunteer?
lines.zh: : 要不我来？

lines.en: : That would probably be for the best, yeah.
lines.zh: : 那样大概最好，嗯。

lines.en: scene libstudy10
: Ugh...fine.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。

lines.en: : Miku, listen closely. Because if I quiz you on this after I'm done speaking and you get all my questions right, we can go get pie.
lines.zh: : Miku，仔细听好。因为我说完之后会考你，要是你全答对了，我们就去吃派。

lines.en: : But after that, it's right back to studying. Got it?
lines.zh: : 不过吃完就立刻回来继续学习。明白吗？

lines.en: : Study now, pie later. Got it.
lines.zh: : 先学习，后吃派。明白。

lines.en: : So, the mitochondria is a double-membrane-bound organelle found in eukaryotic organisms.
lines.zh: : 那么，线粒体是一种存在于真核生物体内、由双层膜包被的细胞器。

lines.en: : It aids in the biochemical process of energy production and respiration.
lines.zh: : 它参与能量生成与呼吸作用的生化过程。

lines.en: : Well said, Makoto. That sounds like something straight out of an Internet definition.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Makoto。听起来简直像是从网上抄下来的定义。

lines.en: : Wait...so are you sayin' this mitochondria things helps plants breathe and stuff?
lines.zh: : 等等……所以你是说这个线粒体的东西是帮植物呼吸什么的？

lines.en: : Not just plants, but animals and people as well.
lines.zh: : 不只是植物，动物和人也一样。

lines.en: : Eukaryotic organisms contain cells with enclosed nuclei, so that means pretty much everything apart from bacteria and algae.
lines.zh: : 真核生物的细胞带有被膜包裹的细胞核，所以除了细菌和藻类之外，几乎万事万物都算。

lines.en: : And, umm...what's a nuclei again?
lines.zh: : 那，呃…… nuclei 又是什么来着？

lines.en: : The plural form of nucleus. You remember what a nucleus is, right?
lines.zh: : nucleus 的复数形式。你记得 nucleus 是什么吧？

lines.en: : Uhhhh...sure!
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……当然记得！

lines.en: scene libstudy11
: Great! So, now that we’ve talked about {i}eukaryotic{/i} organisms, what comes next?
lines.zh: : 很好！那么，既然我们已经讲完{i}真核{/i}生物了，接下来是什么？

lines.en: : Um...uhhh...
: {i}Unkaryotic{/i} organisms?
lines.zh: : {i}假核{/i}生物？

lines.en: : Good guess, but no. What I’m talking about is-
lines.zh: : 猜得不错，不过不对。我要说的是——

lines.en: : Oh wow, would you look at the time?
lines.zh: : 哇哦，看看都几点了？

lines.en: : I have suddenly become aware of a prior engagement. Farewell, students. Don't neglect your education.
lines.zh: : 我突然想起还有个先前的约会。告辞了，同学们。学业可别荒废了。

lines.en: scene mitoredux1
: ...and that’s why you need to- Wait, where did Sensei go?!
lines.zh: : ……所以这就是为什么你需要——等等，Sensei 跑哪儿去了？！

lines.en: : Run, Sensei! Run! Save yourself!
lines.zh: : 快跑，Sensei！快跑！救你自己去吧！

lines.en: I believe I have about five seconds to get out of here before I am killed by the student council president.
lines.zh: 我大概还有五秒钟的时间逃离这里，否则就要被学生会长给宰了。

lines.en: scene mitoredux2
: Oh, look who it is! Sorry for not studying like Makoto asked us to. I just had to-
lines.zh: : 哦，看看这是谁！抱歉我没按 Makoto 的要求去学习。我只是得——

lines.en: : Shh. They’ll hear you.
lines.zh: : 嘘。她们会听见的。

lines.en: scene mitoredux3
: Huh? Who will?
lines.zh: : 啊？谁会听见？

lines.en: : Are you being followed?
lines.zh: : 你被人跟踪了？

lines.en: : I have mace on my keychain. Do you need me to mace someone? Because I'll do it.
lines.zh: : 我钥匙串上有防狼喷雾。你需要我喷谁吗？我可真会喷的。

lines.en: : I don't think that will be necessary. It's just Makoto I'm running from right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没那个必要。我现在躲的只是 Makoto。

lines.en: : Are you {i}sure{/i} you don't need the mace? Because Makoto can be pretty serious when it comes to studying and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}不需要喷雾吗？Makoto 在学习这种事上可是相当认真。

lines.en: : Is there any way you can save me {i}without{/i} macing her?
lines.zh: : 有没有什么办法能{i}不喷她{/i}就救我？

lines.en: scene mitoredux4
: {i}Without macing her...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不喷她的话……{/i}

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Chika, we really don't have the time to-
lines.zh: : Chika，我们真的没时间——

lines.en: scene mitoredux5
: I've got it!
lines.zh: : 想到了！

lines.en: : Come with me and don't ask any questions, okay?
lines.zh: : 跟我来，什么都别问，好吗？

lines.en: scene black
Before I can respond, Chika grabs my hand and pulls me into a nearby room...
lines.zh: 我还没来得及回答，Chika 就抓住我的手，把我拽进旁边的一间屋子……

lines.en: scene mitoredux6
She slams the door behind us, holding it closed so no one (At least no one weaker than her) will be able to come inside.
lines.zh: 她在我们身后砰地关上门，死死顶住，这样谁（至少比她弱的那些人）都进不来。

lines.en: I'm a little surprised at how...assertive and daring this tactic is considering that if anyone saw us go in here together, it could start a whole slew of rumors.
lines.zh: 我有点惊讶于这招竟如此……主动又大胆，毕竟要是有人看见我们一起进了这里，可是会激起一大堆流言的。

lines.en: But I'm not really about to argue with her logic right now as this is essentially a matter of life and death.
lines.zh: 不过我现在也不打算跟她的逻辑争辩，因为这本质上可是生死攸关的大事。

lines.en: : Sorry if this makes you uncomfortable or whatever. But it's the best thing I could think of on short notice that didn't involve mace.
lines.zh: : 要是这样让你不舒服什么的，我很抱歉。不过这是我在这么短时间内能想到的、又不用喷雾的最好办法了。

lines.en: : I am 99%% sure I am not allowed to be in here.
lines.zh: : 我有 99%% 的把握，我是不该待在这儿的。

lines.en: : I won't tell anyone if you don't. Besides, nobody ever comes here after school hours anyway.
lines.zh: : 你不说，我就不说。再说了，放学后根本没人会来这儿。

lines.en: : Don't take that as a free pass to just come on in whenever you want, though. This is only okay because I'm here too.
lines.zh: : 不过你可别把这当成随时都能进来的通行证。只因为我也在，这才没事。

lines.en: : Does that really make it okay?
lines.zh: : 这样真的就没事了吗？

lines.en: : Hmm...I guess that depends on what happens next?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那大概要看接下来会发生什么吧？

lines.en: : You wouldn't try to make a move on a girl who's in the process of saving your life, would you?
lines.zh: : 你总不至于对一个正在救你命的女生下手吧？

lines.en: : If anything, this feels like you making a move on me.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，这感觉更像是你对我下手。

lines.en: scene mitoredux7
: Wait, what? No. No, I was just-
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？不是。不是，我只是——

lines.en: : It's not like that at all!
lines.zh: : 根本不是那么回事！

lines.en: scene mitoredux8
: Why are you just staying quiet?! It's really not like that!
lines.zh: : 你怎么就一直不说话啊？！真的不是那么回事！

lines.en: : I was trying to save you, remember?! {i}Save{/i} you!
lines.zh: : 我是在救你啊，记得吗？！{i}救{/i}你！

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei！

lines.en: scene black
Chika and I hide out for a few more minutes before we decide it’s safe to leave.
lines.zh: 我和 Chika 又躲了几分钟，才认定可以安全离开。

lines.en: Her face remains flushed the entire time.
lines.zh: 她的脸从头红到尾。

lines.en: $ chika_love += 1
$ day12 = True
{i}Chika's affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump afterschool
